description: Search AVAILABLE apartments across Neofort IMO residential projects in Bucharest. Filters: rooms, max price (EUR, excl. VAT), min area, zone/sector, stage, promotions only. Results are sorted by price ascending and include every price option shown on the website (e.g. by down-payment level). All prices are in EUR and EXCLUDE 21% VAT.

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price in EUR, excluding VAT.

min_area_sqm.description: Minimum usable area in square metres.

promo_only.description: Only apartments with an active promotion.

rooms.description: Number of rooms (1 = studio/garsonieră; 4 means 4 or more).

stage.description: finalizat = ready to move in; in_constructie = under construction.
